user.title: Choose your Evohome system
user.description: One Optimum Start entry manages all zones on this controller. The outdoor source is optional; leave it blank to use an assumed temperature.

data.outdoor_temperature_entity: Outdoor temperature sensor or weather entity (optional)

parameters.title: Default zone settings
parameters.description: Zone defaults can be tuned independently. Flow advice is manual and advisory: the initial curve gives 55 °C at 7 °C outdoors, changing by 1 °C for each outdoor degree and staying between 50–65 °C.

data.assumed_outdoor_temperature: Assumed outdoor temperature when no entity is selected (°C)
data.flow_reference_temperature: Flow temperature at the reference outdoor temperature (°C)
data.flow_curve_slope: Flow increase per degree colder outdoors (°C/°C)

error.outdoor_unavailable: The outdoor temperature or weather entity is unavailable or has no numeric current temperature.
error.evohome_service_missing: The official Evohome integration is not loaded or its set_zone_override action is unavailable.
error.flow_maximum_not_above_minimum: Maximum flow temperature must be greater than the minimum.

abort.already_configured: This Evohome system already has an Optimum Start entry. Add another zone to the existing entry.

init.title: System settings
init.description: Weather and flow-advice settings apply to the system. Prediction values are defaults for zones added later. Update the curve anchor if you deliberately establish a different working flow temperature.
